_comment: TuneBridge egg for Pterodactyl (PTDL_v2). Needs an external Postgres (import the official 'Postgres 17' egg from eggs.pterodactyl.io).
name: TuneBridge
author: adm.joostc@gmail.com
description: Self-hosted music playlist transfer, backup and sync (TuneMyMusic / Soundiiz alternative). Runs the web app and the background worker in one container.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
echo 'TuneBridge ships fully inside its image; nothing to install.'

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: The public https URL users open (used to build OAuth redirect URIs).

variables.name: Token encryption keys
variables.description: Format 1:<base64 32 bytes>. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: Active key version
variables.description: Which key version encrypts new tokens.

variables.name: Google sign-in client ID
variables.description: OAuth client ID for Sign in with Google.

variables.name: Google sign-in client secret
variables.description: OAuth client secret for Sign in with Google.

variables.name: Signup policy
variables.description: allowlist (only listed emails), open, or closed. First user becomes admin.

variables.name: Allowed emails
variables.description: Comma-separated emails allowed to sign in.

variables.name: Allowed email domains
variables.description: Comma-separated domains allowed to sign in.

variables.name: Spotify client ID
variables.description: Client ID of YOUR Spotify developer app.

variables.name: Process role
variables.description: all = web + worker in this container.

variables.name: Database pool size
variables.description: Max Postgres connections for the app.

variables.name: Admin Email
variables.description: Optional built-in admin login email (lets you sign in without Google).

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Optional built-in admin login password (12+ characters).
